characters.summary: Frozone is a cool-headed hero who uses ambient moisture to project streams of ice, freeze surfaces, and slide around on self-generated ice paths. He is highly mobile and excels at crowd control and subduing enemies by encasing them in solid ice.

techniques: Creating ice slides for rapid movement

weaknesses: Dehydration reduces his ability to generate ice
limitations: Needs moisture in the air or nearby to generate ice effectively

sources.supports: General background and abilities of Frozone in The Incredibles.

feats.claim: Froze a police officer's gun and trapped a group of robbers in ice during a bank robbery.

campaignTags.claim: Can generate and project ice from his hands.
Can freeze water and moisture in the air to create ice slides and barriers.

characters.summary: Garfield is a lazy, cynical orange tabby cat who relies primarily on wit, insults, and sheer laziness to avoid physical altercations. When forced to act, he utilizes claws and everyday household objects.
weaknesses: Prone to distraction by food, especially lasagna
limitations: Extremely lazy and avoids physical exertion whenever possible

sources.supports: Garfield character traits, habits, and general behavior.

feats.claim: Frequently mails Nermal to Abu Dhabi and manipulates Jon Arbuckle for food.

characters.summary: Gaston is an arrogant hunter relying on peak human physical conditioning, exceptional marksmanship with a musket, and hand-to-hand combat prowess. He commands crowds through charisma and intimidation.
limitations: Lacks supernatural abilities or magical resistance

sources.supports: Character traits, weapons, and fate of Gaston.

feats.claim: Hunts wild game effectively and rallies a mob to attack the Beast's castle.

notableResults.note: Fought the Beast on the castle rooftops before falling.

characters.summary: Genie is a cosmic, shape-shifting entity possessing immense magic power, reality-warping capabilities, and instantaneous teleportation. He fights using absurd transformations, conjuration, and cartoon physics.
weaknesses: Bound by cosmic rules of the lamp until freed
limitations: Phenomenal cosmic power, but constrained by lamp rules when bound

feats.claim: Transformed Aladdin into a prince complete with an entourage and elephants.

characters.summary: Goofy is an anthropomorphic dog whose combat style is defined by unpredictable slapstick physics, accidental resilience, and occasional bursts of surprising competence.

sources.supports: Goofy character history and cartoon appearances.

feats.claim: Survives massive falls and explosions typical of classic animated shorts.

characters.summary: Hades is the fiery, fast-talking Greek god of the underworld who utilizes potent dark magic, pyrokinesis, and a roster of monstrous minions to overwhelm adversaries.
weaknesses: Prone to explosive fits of anger that affect his fire output
limitations: Powers can be neutralized or locked away by planetary alignments or divine constraints

sources.supports: Hades' role, powers, and abilities in Disney's Hercules.

feats.claim: Released the Titans from their subterranean prison to overthrow Mount Olympus.

campaignTags.claim: Possesses divine magical powers as a Greek god.
Hair and body burst into blue or red flames driven by his emotions.
Can levitate and fly as a god.

characters.summary: Hank Hill is a grounded Texan who fights primarily with everyday tools, lawn equipment, and firm propane-based wisdom, relying on standard human capabilities.

techniques: Using tools or a golf club

weaknesses: Narrow urethra and conventional human limitations
limitations: No superhuman strength, speed, or magic

sources.supports: Hank Hill background and realistic human attributes.

feats.claim: Successfully defended his property and subdued opponents using standard physical confrontations.

characters.summary: Hercules is the legendary demigod of immense physical strength, durability, and athletic prowess, engaging enemies directly with overwhelming force and wrestling techniques.
weaknesses: Initial vulnerability when stripped of his godhood (though temporary)
limitations: Relies almost entirely on physical might rather than tactical magic

sources.supports: Hercules strength feats and demigod status.

feats.claim: Lifted and hurled heavy stone pillars and wrestled the multi-headed Hydra.

notableResults.note: Defeated the multi-headed beast by trapping it under falling rocks.

campaignTags.claim: Possesses immense physical stature and superhuman proportions.

characters.summary: Homer Simpson absorbs massive amounts of blunt force trauma with minimal permanent injury due to cartoon resilience, fighting back with clumsy brawling and improvised household items.

mechanisms: Thick layer of body fat absorbing impacts

weaknesses: Low intelligence, easily distracted by food like donuts
limitations: Lacks formal combat training or discipline

sources.supports: Homer Simpson characteristics, resilience, and durability.

feats.claim: Competed successfully as a professional boxer, absorbing heavy punches before tiring.

characters.summary: Jafar is a cunning vizier and sorcerer who employs hypnotic royal staff manipulation, dark magic, shapeshifting into monstrous forms, and serpentine combat tactics.
weaknesses: Arrogance and overconfidence in his newly acquired cosmic powers
limitations: Genie form remains bound to the laws of lamp confinement

feats.claim: Hypnotized the Sultan of Agrabah and later seized the Genie's lamp to become an all-powerful genie.

campaignTags.claim: Practices dark sorcery and hypnosis via his staff.
Casts spells for transformation and energy projection.
Uses a cobra-headed staff for hypnosis.
